outreach_subject: One thought after your wildfire insurance guide

replies.subject: Re: One thought after your wildfire insurance guide
replies.body:
Hi Lisa,

Thanks for reaching out and for the kind words regarding the insurance
guide. Your perspective on construction resilience is very timely and
definitely aligns with the conversations we're seeing in the space.

I'd be happy to chat with Paolo to learn more about your approach. Please
let me know what time works best for a brief call.

Best,

Anthony Will, CEO

On Tue, Aug 18, 2026 at 12:10 AM Lisa Monelli <info@myvilla.la> wrote:

> Hi Firerisk team,
>
> (Writing to the Firerisk newsroom directly — this is meant for
> whichever desk is closest to the topic below. Feel free to forward as
> appropriate.)
>
> Useful guide on wildfire insurance and FAIR Plan options. You
> connected the two halves most explainers leave apart: reinsurance cost
> on one side, carrier withdrawal from the WUI on the other.
>
> A quick introduction: My Villa brings European construction resilience
> and Italian livability to homes in Los Angeles, designed in exposed
> reinforced concrete, cemento a vista. In Europe, resilience has been
> default construction practice for generations.
>
> One thought your piece sparked: the conversation here is almost
> entirely about pricing risk, rarely about building it out. Around the
> Mediterranean, non-combustible construction is simply normal. That
> cultural lag feels like the interesting story.
>
> Would you be interested in receiving more material on what we are
> doing, or in setting up a short call with our founder Paolo?
>
> Best,
> Lisa Monelli
> My Villa Media Team
> info@myvilla.la · myvilla.la
>
